title: A broken project file is an error, not a missing file
as: An engineer whose project file was damaged by a bad edit
goal: In a disposable copy of the doc-pipeline example, break the project's graph file, check that DataPass reports it as an error, then repair it.
hints: This folder is a disposable copy made for this journey: editing it is allowed, nothing else.
Open .datapass/graph.json, delete its last closing brace, save (Ctrl+S). Afterwards undo (Ctrl+Z) and save again.
expected: The Problems panel (Ctrl+Shift+M) lists an error for .datapass/graph.json.
DataPass says the graph file is invalid or cannot be read; it never says the file is absent or that the project has no graph.
After the undo and save, the error disappears and the Architecture view draws the diagram again.
outOfScope: Editing any file outside this disposable copy
